description: This file defines classes related to internal queue management for AWS IoT Python SDK, including an enumeration for drop behaviors, a result code class, and a custom queue class with size and behavior controls.

classes.name: AppendResults
classes.description: Contains constants representing the result codes for append operations in the queue.

classes.name: OfflineRequestQueue
classes.description: A custom list-based queue with size limits and drop behavior, used for offline request management.

methods.name: set_behavior_drop_newest
methods.description: Sets the queue's drop behavior to drop the newest item when full.

methods.name: set_behavior_drop_oldest
methods.description: Sets the queue's drop behavior to drop the oldest item when full.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends data to the queue, handling full or disabled states according to configured behavior.
